name: Card Authorization
description: A card presented at a merchant, authorized or declined inside the scheme timeout. The tightest latency budget in the estate, and the reason the screening call has a circuit breaker rather than a retry.
trigger: Cardholder presents a card at a merchant

name: Dispute and Chargeback
description: A cardholder disputes a transaction. Raised in the contact center, handled in the vendor platform, settled back through the ledger.

name: Installment Loan Application
description: An applicant applies for point-of-sale credit. Bureau search, affordability and a decision, with referral to an underwriter when the automated decision declines to take it.

name: Regulatory Return
description: The monthly supervisory return. Entirely batch, and the only flow whose deadline is external and non-negotiable.
